FAQ_SUBHEADLINE: The answers clients want up front.
FAQ_1_Q: How much does a project cost?
FAQ_1_A: It depends on scope, but every engagement has a clear, fixed price agreed up front. No surprise invoices.
FAQ_2_A: We share a realistic timeline before we start and hit it. Most brand and web projects run a few weeks to a couple of months.
FAQ_3_A: Senior specialists handle your project directly. There are no junior handoffs behind the scenes.
FAQ_4_Q: Do you work with our in-house team?
FAQ_4_A: Often, yes. We plug in as an extension of your team and hand off cleanly when the work is done.
